reason: I only do gummies or drinks, and this is two capsules a day. I also already have a drawer full of half-used bottles, so another one is not happening.
objection: Two capsules a day when I hate swallowing pills. And why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule?
would_change_my_mind: A gummy or drink-mix version of the same thing, with the lab report shown, at around $20 a month.
